pre_condition: path is a Path identifying a filesystem location. text is a string.
post_condition: After return, the file at path contains exactly text as its complete content. Any prior content at path has been replaced. The write is atomic with respect to path: no observer ever sees path in a partially written state — any read of path observes either the entire prior content or the entire new content. If any parent directory of path does not exist, it is created before the write.
